arxiv-2104-14662.title: Dynamic Population Games: A Tractable Intersection of Mean-Field Games and Population Games
arxiv-2104-14662.creator: Ezzat Elokda, Saverio Bolognani, Andrea Censi, Florian Dörfler, Emilio Frazzoli
arxiv-2104-14662.description: Abstract In many real-world large-scale decision problems, self-interested agents have individual dynamics and optimize their own long-term payoffs. Important examples include the competitive access to shared resources (e.g., roads, energy, or bandwidth) but also non-engineering domains like epidemic propagation and control. These problems are natural to model as mean-field games .

arxiv-2206-12470.title: Flow-Induced Buckling of Elastic Microfilaments with Non-Uniform Bending Stiffness
arxiv-2206-12470.creator: Thomas Nguyen, Harishankar Manikantan
arxiv-2206-12470.description: Abstract Buckling plays a critical role in the transport and dynamics of elastic microfilaments in Stokesian fluids. However, previous work has only considered filaments with homogeneous structural properties. Filament backbone stiffness can be non-uniform in many biological systems like microtubules, where the association and disassociation of proteins can lead to spatial and temporal changes into structure.

arxiv-2305-17534.title: Unsupervised Selective Rationalization with Noise Injection
arxiv-2305-17534.creator: Adam Storek, Melanie Subbiah, Kathleen McKeown
arxiv-2305-17534.description: Abstract A major issue with using deep learning models in sensitive applications is that they provide no explanation for their output. To address this problem, unsupervised selective rationalization produces rationales alongside predictions by chaining two jointly-trained components, a rationale generator and a predictor.

arxiv-2405-13524.title: Equivariant neural networks for robust CP observables
arxiv-2405-13524.creator: Sergio Sánchez Cruz, Marina Kolosova, Clara Ramón Álvarez, Giovanni Petrucciani, Pietro Vischia
arxiv-2405-13524.description: Abstract We introduce the usage of equivariant neural networks in the search for violations of the charge-parity ( CP ) symmetry in particle interactions at the CERN Large Hadron Collider. We design neural networks that take as inputs kinematic information of recorded events and that transform equivariantly under the a symmetry group related to the CP transformation.

arxiv-2409-19786.title: Spatio-Temporal Metric-Semantic Mapping for Persistent Orchard Monitoring: Method and Dataset Thanks: We gratefully acknowledge the support of the IoT4Ag Engineering Research Center funded by the National Science Foundation (NSF) under NSF Cooperative Agreement Number EEC-1941529, ARL DCIST CRA W911
arxiv-2409-19786.creator: Jiuzhou Lei, Ankit Prabhu, Xu Liu, Fernando Cladera, Mehrad Mortazavi
arxiv-2409-19786.description: Abstract Monitoring orchards at the individual tree or fruit level throughout the growth season is crucial for plant phenotyping and horticultural resource optimization, such as chemical use and yield estimation. We present a 4D spatio-temporal metric-semantic mapping system that integrates multi-session measurements to track fruit growth over time.

arxiv-2505-03186.title: CoGenAV: Versatile Audio-Visual Representation Learning via Contrastive-Generative Synchronization
arxiv-2505-03186.creator: Detao Bai, Xihan Wei, Liefeng Bo, Zhiheng Ma
arxiv-2505-03186.description: Abstract The inherent synchronization between a speaker’s lip movements, voice, and the underlying linguistic content offers a rich source of information for improving speech processing tasks, especially in challenging conditions where traditional audio-only systems falter. We introduce CoGenAV, a powerful and data-efficient model designed to learn versatile audio-visual representations applicable across a wide range of speech and audio-visual tasks.

arxiv-2508-09350.title: Flow-SLM: Joint Learning of Linguistic and Acoustic Information for Spoken Language Modeling
arxiv-2508-09350.creator: Ju-Chieh Chou, Jiawei Zhou, Karen Livescu
arxiv-2508-09350.description: Abstract Textless spoken language models (SLMs) are generative models of speech that do not rely on text supervision. Most textless SLMs learn to predict the next semantic token, a discrete representation of linguistic content, and rely on a separate vocoder to add acoustic information to the generated speech.

britannica-1911-eschenmayer-adam-karl-au.title: Eschenmayer, Adam Karl August von (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-eschenmayer-adam-karl-au.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-eschenmayer-adam-karl-au.description: Article 'Eschenmayer, Adam Karl August von' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German philosopher and physicist, was born at Neuenburg in Württemberg in July 1768. After receiving his early education at the Caroline academy of Stuttgart, he entered the university of Tübingen, where he received the degree of doctor of medicine. He practised for some time as a physician at Sulz, and then at Kirchheim, and in 1811 he was chosen extraordinary professor of philosophy and medicine at Tübingen.

pmc-10669452.title: Addressing Glaucoma in Myopic Eyes: Diagnostic and Surgical Challenges
pmc-10669452.creator: Kateki Vinod, Sarwat Salim, Karanjit S Kooner, Osamah J Saeedi
pmc-10669452.description: Epidemiological and genetic studies provide strong evidence supporting an association between myopia and glaucoma. The accurate detection of glaucoma in myopic eyes, especially those with high myopia, remains clinically challenging due to characteristic morphologic features of the myopic optic nerve in addition to limitations of current optic nerve imaging modalities.

pmc-11715686.title: Theta‐ and alpha‐band functional connectivity are associated with longitudinal tau accumulation in asymptomatic individuals expressing Aβ pathology
pmc-11715686.creator: Jonathan Gallego Rudolf, Alex I Wiesman, Sylvain Baillet, Sylvia Villeneuve, PREVENT‐AD Research group
pmc-11715686.description: BackgroundRecent studies suggest that tau pathology spreads between functionally connected (FC) brain regions. The accumulation of amyloid‐beta (Aβ) promotes neural hyper‐activity in asymptomatic older adults, which might enhance tau spreading. We assessed the relationship between band‐specific neurophysiological FC and the rate of tau accumulation over time and tested whether this association is dependent on the presence of Aβ pathology.

pmc-12472603.title: Neurovascular Pathophysiology and Emerging Biomarkers in Cerebral Malaria: An Integrative Perspective
pmc-12472603.creator: Damian Pikor, Mikołaj Hurła, Natalia Banaszek-Hurła, Alicja Drelichowska, Małgorzata Paul, Junji Yamauchi
pmc-12472603.description: Cerebral malaria is a life-threatening neurological complication of Plasmodium falciparum infection and a leading cause of pediatric mortality in endemic regions of sub-Saharan Africa. It is defined clinically by coma accompanied by peripheral parasitemia, without alternative causes. Pathogenetically, cytoadherence of parasitized erythrocytes in the cerebral microvasculature, together with a widespread inflammatory response and endothelial activation, causes profound microvascular injury.

pmc-12606901.title: Analysis and comparison of chickenpox outbreaks in two schools at different educational stages: a mixed retrospective observational study
pmc-12606901.creator: Hongxin Lyu, Minhua Chen, Haozheng Zhou, Zhen Zhang, Yu Zeng, Huawei Xiong
pmc-12606901.description: BackgroundVaricella (commonly known as chickenpox) poses a major public health challenge in China, frequently triggering public health emergencies within schools. Distinct age demographics and vaccination rates drive divergent epidemic patterns in primary versus high schools, necessitating comparative analysis of outbreak characteristics and interventions to optimize targeted prevention strategies.

pmc-13241673.title: Successful management of Legionella pneumonia in an immunocompromised infant presenting with generalized pustular rash: A case report
pmc-13241673.creator: Yuanyuan Zeng, Shanshan Wang, Qin Zhang, Hongjun Miao, Jin Xu, Wenjing Li
pmc-13241673.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Legionella infection is rare in children, and extrapulmonary manifestations are even less commonly reported. Cutaneous involvement, particularly in the form of generalized pustular eruptions, may present significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, especially in immunocompromised patients. We report a male infant under 6 months with X-linked severe combined immunodeficiency (XL-SCID) who presented with a disseminated pustular rash as the predominant clinical feature. Initial blood and pus cultures were negative, and empirical antimicrobial therapy showed limited clinical response.

pmc-13683918.title: Organizing Social Citizenship for People Living With Dementia: A Community Case Study
pmc-13683918.creator: Milan van Keulen, Josje Kok, Roland Bal, Anne Margriet Pot
pmc-13683918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study explores a new clustered social housing concept for older people through the lens of social citizenship for people living with dementia. For people living with dementia citizenship occurs most evidently in the ordinary domestic and community spheres. Based on ethnographic fieldwork, including observations and interviews, our analysis reveals how the design of this concept supports creating care-collectives outside of the often prevalent medical view.
